# temps_project (Resource)

A Temps project: an application with its source, build settings and deploy behaviour. Temps creates a `production` environment for every project; read it with the `temps_environment` data source.

Required API key permissions: `projects:create`, `projects:read`, `projects:write`, `projects:delete`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A project deployed from a Dockerfile in a Git repository.
resource "temps_project" "web" {
  name                        = "web"
  source_type                 = "git"
  git_url                     = "https://git.example.com/example/web.git"
  is_public_repo              = true
  main_branch                 = "main"
  preset                      = "dockerfile"
  dockerfile_path             = "Dockerfile"
  exposed_port                = 8080
  automatic_deploy            = true
  enable_preview_environments = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name, unique per Temps installation.

### Optional

- `automatic_deploy` (Boolean) Deploy automatically when the main branch receives a push.
- `build_command` (String) Build command override (presets that build with a package manager).
- `build_context` (String) Docker build context directory.
- `directory` (String) Directory inside the repository that holds the app. Defaults to `.`.
- `dockerfile_path` (String) Path of the Dockerfile (`dockerfile` preset).
- `enable_preview_environments` (Boolean) Create a preview environment for each branch or pull request.
- `exposed_port` (Number) Port the application listens on inside its container. Removing it from the configuration keeps the current value.
- `git_provider_connection_id` (Number) ID of the Git provider connection used to clone private repositories.
- `git_url` (String) Clone URL of the repository. Changing it replaces the project.
- `install_command` (String) Install command override.
- `is_public_repo` (Boolean) Whether the repository is public (cloned without credentials). Changing it replaces the project.
- `main_branch` (String) Branch deployed to production.
- `output_dir` (String) Build output directory (static presets).
- `preset` (String) Build preset, for example `dockerfile`, `nixpacks`, `vite` or `nextjs`.
- `repo_name` (String) Repository name.
- `repo_owner` (String) Repository owner or group.
- `slug` (String) URL slug used in environment hostnames. Derived from `name` when omitted.
- `source_type` (String) Where the code comes from: one of `git`, `docker_image`, `static_files`, `manual`, `external`, `uploaded_source`. Temps defaults to `git`, which needs `repo_owner` and `repo_name`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Numeric project ID.
- `project_type` (String) Kind of project Temps derived from the preset (`server`, `static`, ...).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by numeric ID or by slug.
terraform import temps_project.web 12
terraform import temps_project.web web
```
